mapper.select: SELECT R.REPLY_ID AS "replyId", R.CHAPTER_ID AS "chapterId", R.MEMBER_ID AS "memberId", R.PARENT_REPLY_ID AS "parentReplyId", R.FILE_ID AS "fileId", R.CONTENT AS "content", R.IS_PRIVATE AS "isPrivate", TO_CHAR(R.CREATED_DATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') AS "createdDate", M.NAME AS "name", D.DEPARTMENT_NAME AS "deptName", P.POSITION_NAME AS "positionName" FROM REPLY R JOIN MEMBER M ON (R.MEMBER_ID = M.MEMBER_ID) LEFT JOIN DEPARTMENT D ON (M.DEPARTMENT_ID = D.DEPARTMENT_ID) LEFT JOIN POSITION P ON (M.POSITION_ID = P.POSITION_ID) WHERE R.CHAPTER_ID = #{chapterId} AND R.STATUS = 'Y' START WITH R.PARENT_REPLY_ID IS NULL CONNECT BY PRIOR R.REPLY_ID = R.PARENT_REPLY_ID ORDER SIBLINGS BY R.REPLY_ID ASC
mapper.insert:

INSERT INTO REPLY ( REPLY_ID, CHAPTER_ID, MEMBER_ID, PARENT_REPLY_ID, FILE_ID, CONTENT, IS_PRIVATE ) VALUES ( #{replyId}, #{chapterId}, #{memberId}, #{parentReplyId, jdbcType=INTEGER}, #{fileId, jdbcType=INTEGER}, #{content}, NVL(#{isPrivate}, 'N') )
mapper.update: UPDATE REPLY SET STATUS = 'N', UPDATED_DATE = SYSDATE WHERE REPLY_ID = #{replyId}
